source: What a classic (non-block) theme sends: WooCommerce's add-to-cart.js runs $(document.body).trigger('added_to_cart', [fragments, cart_hash, $thisbutton]), a jQuery-only event that no native listener sees. The arguments are in the order Woo passes them; the button is the add-to-cart link with its data-* attributes, here for the socks recorded in cart.json. Not captured from a live store. The event field names the jQuery event, prefixed jquery:, so the test replays it through a jQuery double.

fixtures.name: added to cart on a classic theme, through jQuery
fixtures.description: No cart object and no price: only the button's product ID, SKU and quantity.
